claims.statement: Theoretical profit is computed as sales (выкупы) minus COGS, advertising, logistics, and storage; missing COGS/tariff data yields a null profit result rather than zero, per AP#8 null-money semantics.
COGS entries are valid per ISO week anchored to Moscow timezone; margin-helpers compute the last completed week and check whether COGS was set after it to decide if margin recalculation is needed.

normalizePriceBasis passes only 'SELLER' and 'STOREFRONT_ANON' through; null/missing/future enum values map to 'UNKNOWN' so the badge indicates an unrecognized basis instead of silently relabeling it as SELLER, and updatePricingBasis runtime-guards the PUT to the two settable values.

Each cabinet carries a nullable targetMarginPct (null means unconfigured, UI falls back to a 20% proposal), persisted via PUT /v1/cabinets/:id as target_margin_pct and normalized by accepting either casing while coercing to number|null (never 0).

getLiquidityTrends throws when the response body lacks meta or has a non-array trends field, so TanStack surfaces isError and the trends section renders its retry branch instead of the normalizer coercing a genuine backend failure to an empty response; a well-formed empty response still passes.

Account balance money fields (current, forWithdraw) are nullable per AP#8 and render as — via formatNullableCurrency; document download returns base64 content that download-blob.ts decodes to a Blob and triggers via a transient anchor click, returning false on empty/malformed base64 with a 1s revoke grace for Firefox.

Communications write-back is a gated async API: all write routes return HTTP 202 {jobId, status} for BullMQ jobs, a 403 from the 4-factor gate (auth + cabinet + env/arm/token write switch) surfaces as a RU 'disabled' message, and confirmationToken is presence-only and rotated fresh per user gesture by the hook — this module never invents a token.

The chats endpoint returns a threads list (no chatId) or a single thread + messages (with chatId); an empty-string chatId collapses to list mode sharing the same cache entry as undefined to avoid a cache split.

Price-calculator cost-breakdown domain logic lives in non-component modules: cost-breakdown-types.ts defines ChartInputParams, ChartSegment, a design-token CHART_COLORS palette, and MIN_SEGMENT_WIDTH_PX = 24 for non-zero segments; cost-breakdown-helpers.ts re-exports them and builds segments that return [] when recommendedPrice <= 0, derive the fixed-cost base as price minus percentage segments and margin, and sort by size with margin last.

margin-status-helpers.ts defines the calculator margin tiers via MARGIN_STATUS_CONFIG (Russian labels; since D-4/2026-09-02 good and warning use solid status pairs bg-status-success/text-status-success-foreground and bg-status-warning/text-status-warning-foreground for WCAG 1.4.3 contrast, while excellent and critical keep /15 financial-token tints) and getMarginStatus/getMarginColor thresholds: >=20% excellent, >=10% good, >=5% warning, else critical — distinct from the cabinet targetMarginPct and the analytics PROFITABILITY_STATUS_CONFIG tier systems.
Analytics operate on ISO weeks anchored to Moscow timezone (UTC+3); week boundaries, navigation, ranges, and period comparisons come from src/lib/iso-week/ modules and date utilities.

null-helpers.ts enforces the 'null not undefined' standard (isNullish, coerceToNull, hasValue, nullSafe) underpinning AP#8 semantics where missing money/ratio data stays null, and decimal-utils.ts parseDecimal handles Prisma DECIMAL strings.

Backfill retry routes per source through a RETRY_PATH map in retryBackfill (POST /v1/admin/backfill/report/retry vs /analytics/retry, keyed by 'reports' | 'analytics') and normalizes the response to {success, message} with an attempt counter.

monitor-metrics-utils.ts (172.11 extraction) keeps the monitor metrics table presentational: computeDelta is null-safe (— when either value is null or the base is 0, exactly-zero change is a neutral muted label with no arrow) and colors improvement direction-aware via 'higher-is-better' | 'higher-is-worse'; hasAnomaly/getAnomalyPeriods detect advisory anomalies (COGS > revenue or margin > revenue) and return offending periods with labels for tooltips.

monitor-weekly-chart-utils.ts adapts DailyMetrics into three integer-count chart series on a uniform scale where the 'orders' series is actually the derived transaction sum salesCount + returnsCount (BD-22), labeled «Продажи + Возвраты» rather than «Заказы»; weekday labels are capitalized Russian via a local capitalize() over date-fns ru locale, and LINE_COLORS/LINE_LABELS are the single source of series tokens.

monitor-pipeline-utils.ts encodes the buyout gauge's 3-band mapping (null→gray «Нет данных», <70→red, 70–89→amber, ≥90→green), intentionally diverging from BuyoutRateCard's simpler 80% two-band cutoff; it also provides getMostRecentRecalc (latest non-null lastSuccessAt or null), order-preserving getUnhealthyPipelines, and formatRelativeTime using manual-math Russian relative strings (null → «—») mirroring PipelineStatusGrid (M-8).

health-history-helpers.ts formatDayLabel fixes the BD-30 timezone bug: a bare YYYY-MM-DD is parsed by new Date() as UTC midnight, shifting the weekday back one day in Europe/Moscow (UTC+3), so a T00:00:00 suffix is appended for date-only strings while timestamped strings pass through unchanged; the module also owns PERIOD_OPTIONS (7/14/30 days), status color/ring/emoji maps, and countByStatus for the trend summary.

data-completeness-constants.ts is pure config/helpers for the monitoring data-completeness table: COMPLETENESS_BADGE (complete/incomplete/critical badge variants), HEALTH_CONFIG (status labels + health-bar classes), getOverallPercent (rounded mean completeness ratio, 0 for an empty list), and a non-mutating sortByCompleteness ordering worst tables first.

Story 174.3 a11y change in roi-profit-utils: getROIColor returns text-foreground for any measured ROI (null/undefined → text-muted-foreground), so color no longer encodes ROI direction — the value and getROIRating labels carry the meaning; the tests assert the new tokens (some test names still say green-600 but expect text-foreground) while numeric semantics (rating thresholds >=100/50/20/0, null rules, formatROI) are unchanged.

formatROI expects percent-units (0–100, matching calculateROI's (profit/cogs)*100 and the backend roi field), formats via canonical Russian-locale formatPercentage (comma + NBSP, 1 decimal) with null → em dash; calculateROI and calculateProfitPerUnit return null (never 0) when profit is null or the divisor is null/zero.

Profitability uses a shared six-status taxonomy with fixed operating-margin thresholds: excellent >25%, good 15–25%, warning 5–15%, critical 0–5%, loss <0%, unknown = COGS not assigned — declared both in EXTENDED_STATUS_CONFIG (profitability-utils.ts, with colors/classes/recommendations) and ProfitabilityStatus/PROFITABILITY_COLORS/PROFITABILITY_LABELS (sku-financials/core.ts, 168.11 /15-chip token classes).

useWeeklyFinancialSeries keeps each ISO week separate for the /analytics/finance-history grid: one useQueries entry per week against /v1/analytics/weekly/finance-summary?week= (key ['financial','summary',week,'week']), each passing the same single-week aggregateFinanceSummaries margin-consistency pass as useFinancialSummary (with RUS+EAEU product transactions summed); isSettled is true only when every requested week resolved.

efficiency-utils.ts centralizes the five advertising efficiency statuses (excellent/good/moderate/poor/loss plus boundary-honest unknown) with Russian labels, Lucide icons, Tailwind classes, ROAS/ROI classification descriptions and recommendations; alert-dismissal state and accessor helpers are re-exported from extracted modules (efficiency-alert-state.ts, efficiency-accessors.ts) for file-size compliance.

Returns-analytics types apply boundary-honest AP#8 semantics: ReturnCategory includes 'unknown' for unrecognized backend categories (indicate, never coerce), overallReturnRate/classificationCoverage are number|null rendering em dash, and BySkuReturnItem.returnRate is null when salesCount is unavailable — a fabricated 0 would color a high-return SKU green/healthy.
